samples.gvd:
module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter	WIDTH = 8,
    parameter 	DEPTH = 16,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define the dual-port RAM instance here
        <instance id="ram_inst">
            <module_ref id="dual_port_RAM"/>
            <connection id="wclk" port_id="wclk"/>
            <connection id="rclk" port_id="rclk"/>
            <connection id="wen" port_id="wenc"/>
            <connection id="ren" port_id="renc"/>
            <connection id="waddr" port_id="waddr"/>
            <connection id="raddr" port_id="raddr"/>
            <connection id="wdata" port_id="wdata"/>
            <connection id="rdata" port_id="rdata"/>
        </instance>
        
        // Define the write and read controllers here
        <reg id="waddr_bin" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write address register.</reg>
        <reg id="raddr_bin" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read address register.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            // Write controller logic
            if (winc && !wfull) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
            end
            
            // Read controller logic
            if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Define the read pointer synchronizers here
        <reg id="wptr" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write pointer register.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_buff" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write pointer buffer register.</reg>
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr <= waddr_bin ^ (waddr_bin >> 1);
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Define the write pointer synchronizers here
        <reg id="rptr" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read pointer register.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read pointer buffer register.</reg>
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr <= raddr_bin ^ (raddr_bin >> 1);
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Define the full and empty signals here
        <assign id="wfull" value="(wptr == {~rptr_buff[3], rptr_buff[2:0]});"/>
        <assign id="rempty" value="(rptr == wptr_syn);"/>
        
        // Connect the input and output signals to the dual-port RAM instance
        <assign id="wen" value="winc & !wfull;"/>
        <assign id="ren" value="rinc & !rempty;"/>
        <assign id="waddr" value="waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];"/>
        <assign id="raddr" value="raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];"/>
        <assign id="wdata" value="wdata;"/>
        <assign id="rdata" value="rdata;"/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Implement the dual-port RAM module here
        module dual_port_RAM(
            input clk,
            input wen,
            input ren,
            input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] addr,
            input [WIDTH-1:0] data_in,
            output reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_out
        );
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [DEPTH-1:0];
            
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (wen) begin
                    RAM_MEM[addr] <= data_in;
                end
                
                if (ren) begin
                    data_out <= RAM_MEM[addr];
                end
            end
        endmodule
    </implementation>
</module>
